text:
oliver.pm: Quick one  rented an e-bike and a dockless scooter during a customer trip to get between sites. Both vendors provided QR receipts in-app. Can I expense these micromobility rides plus claim per-diem for the day?

sophie.peopleops: Yes, micromobility (bikes/scooters) used for business travel are reimbursable. Attach the QR receipt screenshot and the card/bank line. Per-diem is independent of short transit rides  only meals provided by vendor/hotel affect per-diem. :bicyclist:

ian.finance: Finance notes: Upload the vendor QR + bank statement or card line. Category = Travel > Ground - Local. For in-app credits (e.g., 10-trip passes) please show the pass purchase receipt and pro-rate per-ride if mixed personal/business.

oliver.pm: I bought a day pass (10 rides) and used 3 rides for work and 7 personal while extending the trip weekend. How do I split?

sophie.peopleops: For multi-ride passes, pro-rate the pass cost by business rides used. In the expense form, show a short breakdown and attach the app's usage history screenshot. Example note: "10-ride pass \u20ac25; 3 business rides = \u20ac7.50 reimbursable". Manager approval required for splits.

ian.finance: If the pass auto-billed via corporate card, flag it and we'll reconcile personal portion. If personal card, submit the pro-rated amount for reimbursement. For small amounts (< \u20ac50) we accept the app history + statement; larger amounts may require manager confirmation.

oliver.pm: The QR receipt for one scooter was lost (battery died) but I have the trip history and card line. Is that OK?

sophie.peopleops: Yes  trip history screenshot + bank statement is fine. Mark "missing QR" in notes and tag your manager. If vendor provides a trip export, attach it.

ian.finance: Also check for VAT/tax lines in vendor receipts. Many dockless vendors are consumer-focused and don't provide VAT invoices. VAT reclaim unlikely for those, but we still reimburse the net amount.

oliver.pm: Small nuance  one of the scooter rides included a promotional free coffee redemption at a partner cafe (redeemed in-app). Does that reduce my per-diem?

sophie.peopleops: Good catch. If the vendor explicitly provides a meal (free coffee) as part of the paid pass and it's a meaningful meal item, deduct its reasonable value from the meal per-diem. For single small items (coffee) we usually don't reduce per-diem unless the value is material (> \u20ac10) or it was an actual meal (breakfast/lunch). Note it in the expense.

ian.finance: If you're unsure, itemize the small purchase and submit it; Finance will advise during review.

oliver.pm: Can memberships to bike-share schemes (monthly plans) be reimbursed if purchased for a customer travel month?

sophie.peopleops: Monthly memberships are usually NOT reimbursed retroactively. Exception: if pre-approved for a specific customer program or extended on-site work. Require manager + finance pre-approval and pro-rate reimbursement for the business period only.

ian.finance: Pre-approval should include justification and dates. If approved, show membership invoice and usage history for the dates covered. We'll pro-rate the refund to the business days.

expense-bot: Reminder: set cost_center and project_code on the expense. Use the Travel template or it will be routed back. Missing approver = returned expense.

oliver.pm: Thanks  one last thing: how do I document multi-leg micromobility tied to a single day with per-diem? Example: breakfast on my own (claimed via per-diem), 2 work rides midday, client took care of dinner.

sophie.peopleops: Per-diem: claim as usual for meals, then deduct any client-hosted meals. Short local rides don't affect per-diem. In your notes, state which meals were client-hosted and which were personal. Manager approval required for any deductions.

ian.finance: Sample note to paste:
```
Local micromobility and meals 2026-08-18:
- 10-ride e-mobility pass (vendor AppX) \u20ac25.00; 3 business rides used = \u20ac7.50 reimbursed (usage screenshot attached).
- Individual scooter ride (vendor Y) \u20ac3.20 (QR receipt attached).
- Per-diem claimed for full day \u20ac45. Dinner provided by client on 2026-08-18 (value approx \u20ac30) 1 deduct from per-diem. Manager @linda.sales approved 2026-08-20.
```

oliver.pm: Pasted and submitted, attaching app history. Thanks for the quick clarity! :raised_hands:
